title: The Pencil Cup with Two Sharp Ones
youtube_title: The Pencil Cup with Two Sharp Ones | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: What is split with care does not become less important.
summary: At a school cloakroom and the lunch mats just beyond, Farah sees that a pencil cup with two pencils still sharp will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Farah makes a smaller, even share so Yuri is included, and Uncle Idris lets the choice stand without a speech.
